name: anything-llm
description: The best solution for turning private documents into a chat bot using off-the-shelf tools and commercially viable AI technologies.
author: Timothy Carambat (Mintplex Labs)

scripts.lint: cd server && yarn lint && cd ../collector && yarn lint
scripts.lint:ci: cd server && yarn lint:check && cd ../collector && yarn lint:check
scripts.setup: cd server && yarn && cd ../collector && yarn && cd .. && yarn setup:envs && yarn prisma:setup && echo "Please run yarn dev:server and yarn dev:collector in separate terminal tabs."
scripts.setup:envs:
cp -n ./server/.env.example ./server/.env.development; cp -n ./collector/.env.example ./collector/.env; cp -n ./docker/.env.example ./docker/.env; echo "All ENV files copied!
"
scripts.prisma:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev --name init
scripts.prisma:seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
scripts.prisma:setup: yarn prisma:generate && yarn prisma:migrate && yarn prisma:seed
